contexts.text: To multiply stumbling blocks () = that man sees nothing of good and truth, but mere falsities and things contrary.
Men after death, when permitted by the Lord, can meet all whom they have Known... AC 5229:end.
Then shall many be offended () = enmity in themselves.
Where the good meets with any truth...
To fear God means to offend Him; and to offend Him is to sin...
To stumble at noonday as in the twilight () = to wander in falsities although they can be in light from the Word. AE 781:18.
Before your feet stumble at the mountains of twilight (). Explained.
